author: felicepantaleo
body:
The hitless-subgraph pruning of `TruthLogicalGraphProducer` (`postProcessing.dropHitlessSimSubgraphs`) deletes every SIM particle whose subgraph has no sim hit. At DIGI it read the calorimeter, tracker and muon sim hits, but not the MTD sim hits that `TruthGraphAccumulator` writes as `mix:mergedMtdHits`. A particle with only MTD hits was deleted without a warning. The DIGI hit index did not fill the MTD channel.

This PR adds the parameter `mtdSimHitCollections` (PSimHit, matched by `trackId()` like the tracker and muon hits). The default is `g4SimHits:FastTimerHitsBarrel` and `g4SimHits:FastTimerHitsEndcap`. The DIGI configuration `truthGraphMixedDigi_cff` sets it to `mix:mergedMtdHits`.

The DIGI hit index and `customiseTruthReduced` now fill the MTD channel from `mix:MergedMtdTruthLC` and the MTD topology. The premix path does not build the index, so it does not change.

The test `truthGraphMixedDigi_t.py` checks that the pruning reads every sim-hit family that the accumulator merges, and that the hit index fills the channel of each family, in the default and in the reduced configuration.
title: TruthInfo: the hitless-subgraph pruning reads the MTD sim hits, and the DIGI hit index fills the MTD channel
